Class Boat

java.lang.Object
Boat
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Boat extends Object implements Serializable
One boat in the Coconut Grove Sailing Club fleet. A boat knows its details and how much has been spent maintaining it, and applies the Commodore's policy that no more may be spent on a boat than it cost.
Version:
1.0 November 2026
Author:
Gracielle Boucher
